title: Billing
snippet:
## Daily Free Tier
All App Services Apps in a MongoDB Atlas project share a single daily free tier. All usage below the free tier thresholds in a given day is not billed.
### Free Tier Thresholds
App Services is free to use below the following daily free tier thresholds:
- 50,000 requests
- 25 hours of compute
- 30,000 minutes of sync runtime
- 0.5 GB of data transfer
## Invoicing and Payment
App Services is billed as part of MongoDB Atlas. Invoices are sent monthly and include all costs incurred from going over the daily free tier limits.

**Price:** $2.00 / 1,000,000 requests ($0.000002 / request)
**Formula:** (Function Executions + Trigger Executions + GraphQL/Webhook/HTTPS Endpoint Requests + Sync Updates) * $0.000002
**Free Tier Threshold:** 50,000 requests, 25 hours of compute, and 30,000 minutes of sync runtime

The memory multiplier begins at 1 (i.e. it does not affect your billing rate) and increases by 1 for every 32MB of memory that a given request uses.
**Price:** $10.00 / 500 runtime hours (~$0.000000005 / ms)
**Formula:** (Number of Requests) * (Runtime (ms)) * (Memory (MB) / 32MB) * $0.000000005 / ms
**Free Tier Threshold:** 50,000 requests, 25 hours of compute, and 30,000 minutes of sync runtime

App Services counts the total amount of time in which a client application user has an active connection to the sync server even if they are not transferring data at the time. Sync is billed at a set rate for each millisecond of sync runtime per user.
**Price:** $0.08 / 1,000,000 runtime minutes ($0.00000008 / min)
**Formula:** (Number of Active Users) * (Sync Time (min / user)) * ($0.00000008 / min)
**Free Tier Threshold:** 50,000 requests, 25 hours of compute, and 30,000 minutes of sync runtime
Device Sync pauses automatically after 30 days of inactivity.

### **Free Tier Usage**
The way that free tier usage affects your bill depends on your consumption each day. Consumption can look different on any individual day.

title: Estimate Atlas Flex Cluster Costs and Usage - Atlas - MongoDB Docs
snippet:
Flex clusters are capped at $30 per month. You pay a monthly base price, which includes:
- 5GB storage
- 100 operations/sec
- unlimited data transfer
Flex clusters scale with your usage. If you use additional operations/sec, MongoDB charges you based on the following pricing tiers.
## Usage Cost Summary
As a user of an Atlas Flex cluster, you pay between $8 and $30 for 30 days of usage. As for all Atlas clusters, the Flex cluster tier follows a pay-as-you-go model billed hourly.
The following table outlines the pricing for Flex clusters. Note that there is a volume discount as your usage increases.
| Tier (ops/second) | Marginal Monthly Cost | Effective Discount | Total Monthly Cost | Total Hourly Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 - 100 (Base) | $8.00 | 0% | $8.00 | $0.0110 |
| 100 - 200 | $7.00 | 12.5% | $15.00 | $0.0205 |
| 200 - 300 | $6.00 | 25% | $21.00 | $0.0288 |
| 300 - 400 | $5.00 | 37.5% | $26.00 | $0.0356 |
| 400 - 500 | $4.00 | 50% | $30.00 | $0.0411 |

| Tier | Cost | Best For |
|---|---|---|
| Free cluster (`M0`) | No cost | Learning MongoDB, prototyping, and other workloads that fit within the [Atlas Free Cluster Limits.](https://mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/free-shared-limitations/#std-label-atlas-free-tier) |
| Flex cluster | $8 to $30 per month, based on usage | Development, testing, and low-traffic production workloads that need modern database features such as MongoDB Search, MongoDB Vector Search, and Atlas Stream Processing, without managing dedicated infrastructure. |
| Dedicated cluster (`M10+`) | Starts at $60 per month | Production workloads that need dedicated hardware, consistent resources, granular backup configuration, or features that Flex clusters don't support. |

title: Pricing
snippet:
Key considerations include:
- **Free Tier (M0):** Best for learning and exploring, with [limited resources](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/free-shared-limitations/).
- **Flex:** Ideal for development and testing, offering the lowest cost option with certain [feature limitations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/flex-limitations/#std-label-atlas-flex-limitations).
- **Dedicated (M10 & M20):** Suitable for pre-production and small, non-critical workloads. These tiers utilize shared vCPUs and support replica set deployments offering fully featured access to Atlas.
- **Dedicated (M30+):** Recommended for performance-critical and high-traffic workloads, supporting both replica sets and sharded clusters with fully featured access to Atlas with dedicated vCPUs.

### Does MongoDB Atlas offer any discounts?
MongoDB Atlas offers discounts through free credits for startups, educators, and students.

title: Atlas Triggers Usage-Based Billing - Atlas - MongoDB Docs
snippet:
## Daily Free Tier
All Triggers in a Atlas project have a daily free tier. Atlas doesn't bill usage below the following daily free tier thresholds:
## Invoicing and Payment
Your MongoDB Atlas bill includes a line item for Triggers. Atlas sends invoices monthly that include all costs incurred from going over the daily free tier thresholds.
You can pay for Triggers with all payment methods that work with Atlas, including prepaid Atlas Credits. Atlas bills any costs associated with a linked Atlas cluster, such as database operations and backup, separately from Triggers.

**Price:** Tiered daily rates based on the number of requests:
- $2.00 / 1,000,000 requests ($0.000002 / request) for the first 25,000,000 requests
- $1.00 / 1,000,000 requests ($0.000001 / request) for requests 25,000,001 to 250,000,000
- $0.75 / 1,000,000 requests ($0.00000075 / request) for requests above 250,000,000
**Free Tier Threshold:** 50,000 requests
